title: Overworld
description: Your home and departure point. Follow Exploration for Alex's Caves, Cataclysm ruins, settlements and underground expeditions.

title: The Aether
description: Build a glowstone gateway and pour water into its frame. The islands hold three dungeon tiers, enchanted minerals and moa companions.

title: Everbright
description: Seek a Gatekeeper and consult the Blue Journal. Carry a Zeal Lighter to open the Everbright portal; local tools matter in this cold realm.

title: Everdawn
description: Find the Gatekeeper's Everdawn portal and light it with a Zeal Lighter. This warmer sister realm has its own materials, alchemy and dungeon guardians.

title: The Undergarden
description: Craft a Catalyst and awaken a stone-brick portal. Beneath the surface lie strange crops, Stoneborn traders and forgotten metal guarded in the catacombs.

title: The Otherside
description: Seek an Ancient City and the Warden's Heart. Open its great frame and descend with spare light, protection and room for echo-rich discoveries.

title: The Bumblezone
description: Throw an ender pearl into a bee nest or hive. The honeycomb world holds royal trades, ancient structures and trials; treat its inhabitants carefully.

title: Twilight Forest
description: Follow the courtyard, tower, swamp and glacier expeditions in Twilight Forest. Defeating each guardian opens the next reaches of the forest.

title: Abydos
description: Survey the desert and record its gate address.

title: Chulak
description: Establish a safe return point on Chulak.

title: Cavum Tenebrae
description: Bring light and survey the dark terrain.

title: Rima
description: Scout a landing area before shipping machinery.

title: Tollan
description: Survey Tollan and add it to your gate network.

title: Lantea
description: Prepare for an ocean expedition before leaving the gate.

title: Athos
description: Mark a safe campsite on Athos.

title: Unitas
description: Scout Unitas and record a route back.

title: Destiny
description: Prepare for a distant journey and confirm a return route before departure.

title: Moon
description: Follow the rocket tiers in Ad Astra. Pack oxygen, fuel and suitable protection. Bring desh home to advance the next rocket tier.

title: Mars
description: Follow the rocket tiers in Ad Astra. Pack oxygen, fuel and suitable protection. Bring ostrum home to advance the next rocket tier.

title: Venus
description: Follow the rocket tiers in Ad Astra. Pack oxygen, fuel and suitable protection. Bring calorite home to advance the next rocket tier.

title: Mercury
description: Follow the rocket tiers in Ad Astra. Pack oxygen, fuel and suitable protection. Survey the terrain and establish a supplied expedition camp.

title: Glacio
description: Follow the rocket tiers in Ad Astra. Pack oxygen, fuel and suitable protection. Survey the terrain and establish a supplied expedition camp.

title: Earth Orbit
description: Optional orbital station space. Open Orbital Stations for arrival and life-support projects.

title: Glacio Orbit

title: Nether
description: Build an obsidian portal. Bring fire protection, spare blocks and a marked path home. Incendium adds further ruins to explore.

title: End
description: Find a stronghold and open its gateway. Carry spare blocks and a return plan before facing the dragon.

title: Dungeon Pockets
description: Explore a dimensional dungeon through a rift. Watch each room before taking another door; the wrong turn can lead to Limbo.

title: Personal Pockets
description: Create a personal pocket through Dimensional Doors and establish a quiet workshop.

title: Shared Pockets
description: Create a shared pocket and test its doorway from both sides before storing valuables.

title: Limbo
description: A dangerous place beyond the doors. If you arrive here, concentrate on finding a way home; this journey is optional.

title: Endless Realm
description: Follow the Edge of the Hidden Realm ritual in Sanguine Scientiem. Explore the dungeon for materials that advance Blood Magic.

title: Pocket Dimension
description: Follow the Pocket Dimension spell in the spellbook. Establish a retreat and test the return before leaving equipment inside.

title: Reality Marble
description: Study Reality Marble in the Mahou Tsukai guide. This is a magical ability space, not a conventional expedition world.

title: TARDIS Interiors
description: Each vessel has its own interior. Follow the TARDIS branch to enter, maintain and pilot yours.

title: Spatial Storage
description: Spatial cells hold isolated spaces. Follow A Room in a Cell in Applied Energistics; test a small powered chamber before moving valuable machinery.

title: The Past
description: A realm recorded by The Graveyard. It is not treated as an ordinary portal destination in this expedition atlas; no visit is required.
